findings.claim: 公司 10-K 風險因子自述：AI、低程式碼/無程式碼等能力日益重要，公司正與替代方案與做法競爭，且預期隨產品進入新鄰近市場會有更多競爭。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: With this rapid evolution, we are increasingly competing with alternative solutions and approaches to solve customer needs, and we expect additional competition as we shift our products and services to compete with providers in new and adjacent markets.

findings.claim: 公司 10-K 自述平台架構可讓客戶部署 AI 強化工作流程而不必替換既有技術基礎設施，定位為 AI 分析與流程執行層之間的連接。
findings.excerpt: our platform’s architecture, developed over years of iteration with customer feedback, allows organizations to deploy AI-enhanced workflows without replacing their existing technology infrastructure or disrupting established processes.

findings.claim: 二手評論稱 AI 工具（如 Claude Code）降低軟體開發門檻，企業可能自建內部工作流工具；且 agent 取代人力可能減少座位授權。
findings.source: 247WallSt: ServiceNow was the SaaS stock AI was supposed to kill

findings.claim: Seeking Alpha 文章稱 ServiceNow 為 SaaSpocalypse 主要受害者，涉及座位制軟體模式受 AI agent 衝擊。
findings.source: Seeking Alpha: ServiceNow Is The Main Victim Of The SaaSpocalypse

findings.claim: Futurum 分析稱 ServiceNow 定位為 AI 控制層，但競爭者正建立類似治理能力。

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋摘要僅得二手評論（座位制風險、自建工具、公司轉非座位計價），無可逐字原文，列為 clues。 線索 3 條，程式核實 0 條，3 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
